description: Amir Loop - auto-arming Stop hook that keeps a session going until the work is done

hooks.command: bash -lc 'r=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; [ x$r != x ] || r=$PLUGIN_ROOT; [ x$r != x ] || r=$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT; [ x$r != x ] || exit 0; case x$r in x[A-Za-z]:*) r=$(cygpath -u "$r" 2>/dev/null) ;; esac; [ x$r != x ] || exit 0; exec bash "$r/hooks/amir-loop-stop.sh" --observe=session.started'
